name: era-0-0-39-flattens-content
description: a 0.0.39 peer receives flattened text content, and the parts it cannot receive are reported rather than dropped in silence
kill: remove the content flattening from BackwardCompatibility_0_0_39, or its dropped-parts warning. NOT the version gate: this fixture pins an eligible peer, so making the shim unconditional leaves it installed and the fixture green — the gate is killed by era-current-peer-keeps-modern-content instead

dotnet.intentional: The compatibility shims are TypeScript client middleware; the .NET client has no equivalent, so nothing flattens the content and nothing warns. The image part is described 1.0 material, so — unlike the retired binary part in era-0-0-47 — it deserializes cleanly and is sent to the 0.0.39 peer verbatim, which is exactly the loss this shim exists to prevent; the request below pins that unflattened shape. `warnings` is emptied only to displace the base expectation, since an override replaces a key rather than removing it; `noWarnings` is what actually asserts the silence. Alignment is tracked separately.
